crossRefs.note: The caravans that travel beside them turn away. They go up into the waste, and perish.

translations.web: The caravans that travel beside them turn away. They go up into the waste, and perish.
translations.bsb: Caravans turn aside from their routes; they go into the wasteland and perish.
translations.kjv: The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, and perish.
translations.asv: The caravans that travel by the way of them turn aside; They go up into the waste, and perish.
